title: Cardi B Teases Potential ‘Ah Ha’ Remix With Kash Doll: ‘It’s Too Fire’
summary: Cardi says she's shooting the music video to her latest single in the coming days.
contentText:
Cardi B has responded to fans who want to see Kash Doll featured on the “Ah Ha” remix after Cardi shouted out the Detroit rapper on her latest single.

Following Cardi’s first release of the year on Friday (July 31), the Bronx rapper hopped on Instagram Live on Monday (Aug. 3) to address a few topics, including a potential “Ah Ha” remix with Kash Doll.

“Talking about Kash Doll, right, so I know a lot of y’all want to see her on the remix. I’m debating if I want to put her on the remix because… I’m not gonna say it,” she teased, indicating that perhaps something bigger is on the horizon. “Just know, I got 11 houses. That’s what I’ma say. It’s too fire. She knows. I’m debating because it’s too fire.”

Kash Doll posted a clip to social media rapping along to Cardi’s “Ah Ha,” including the part of the track where Cardi B gives Kash a shout.

Cardi revealed she’s going to be shooting the “Ah Ha” music video in the coming days. “Probably like a week, less,” she said. “I just rehearsed for something, then I gotta do rehearsal for the music video tomorrow. I’m doing two things, like a b—h is working.”

The 33-year-old also detailed her plans to throw a party in New York City this week. She’s targeting Thursday (Aug. 6) since Chris Brown and Usher’s R&B Tour is in town with a pair of shows slated for Friday (Aug. 7) and Saturday (Aug. 8) at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey.

It’s been a celebratory week for Cardi B, who picked up her fourth diamond plaque with the RIAA certifying “WAP” featuring Megan Thee Stallion as 10x platinum on Monday.

“Awww y’all WAP just went diamond… me and @thestallion really did that!! Love y’all so much.. thank you for streaming and making history with us,” Cardi wrote on X.

“WAP” arrived in August 2020 and debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 , where it remained for four nonconsecutive weeks. It’s the first female rap collab to go diamond.
